verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 5 remains clean. The fix lane re-derives the source issue route once, constrains the model chain from that result, and adopts its persona only through the target-owned boolean capability declaration. The final published persona is checked after fallback selection: on a capability-enabled target, false, absent, malformed, blank, and non-string declarations refuse the mutating lane, while targets that have not introduced an agents table retain the documented legacy implementer. Review mode does not enter the fix-only refusal. The workflow tests execute the production selection block, distinguish route adoption from role fallback, cover both live routing and malformed synthetic shapes, kill targeted non-crashing mutants for each decision, and pin the exact resolve-output-to-worker seam. The checked-in capability table is also tested against every routed persona and the actual brief loaded by the worker. The worker independently validates the agent as a safe atom and requires a regular, non-symlink brief. No injected reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff, and no blocker, major, or lesser issue is supported by the diff-scoped evidence.
